items.title: Incrementality
clues: I am about cause, not just correlation.
I ask what would have happened without the ad.
I tell you the extra sales an ad really drove.
items.why: Incrementality is the extra result caused by advertising.

items.title: Lookback window
clues: I am a span of time.
I set how long a conversion can be credited to an ad.
Click windows are often shorter than view windows.
Too short and you miss sales. Too long and you over-credit.
items.why: A lookback window decides how late a conversion can still count.

items.title: Reach
clues: I tell you how many different people saw a campaign.
Show the same ad ten times to one person and I still say one.
items.why: Reach is the number of different people exposed.
